demos.title: 一句呐喊的瞬时定位
demos.note: 2 秒短事件，检验模型能否在高能背景中锁定一句特定人声。
demos.query: 定位出在结尾激烈的模拟战斗声中，男性唯一一次激动地呐喊出“我要报仇！”这句短语的时刻。

demos.title: 第一次描述独特味道
demos.note: 需要结合人物、内容与首次出现约束定位一段完整描述。
demos.query: 定位出男性博主品尝他在长春的第一顿饭——麻辣烫，并评价其味道带有独特“中药味”的首次描述。

demos.title: 寻亲过程的关键转折
demos.note: 较长的人声语义事件，起止边界依赖完整论述结构。
demos.query: 定位出节目组的男性代表首次详细介绍寻亲过程的关键转折点，具体提及了他们是如何在寻亲网站上发现一条2015年的求助帖，且该帖子的求助人、事发地点等信息与女嘉宾的描述高度吻合的段落。

demos.title: 五十秒完整观点
demos.note: 目标几乎覆盖整段音频，适合检查长事件的边界稳定性。
demos.query: 定位出罗老师首次回应成名影响时，强调自己核心本分是“做一名称职的老师”的完整论述。

demos.title: A one-second decision
demos.note: A very short semantic event requiring precise localization of a decisive response.
demos.query: Locate the first instance where a generous and decisive teenage boy, in response to his new friend's inability to buy snacks from the trolley, decides to purchase the entire selection.

demos.title: The comparison-trap quote
demos.note: A medium-length spoken quotation with a clear semantic anchor.
demos.query: Locate the exact moment the male host delivers the key quote to combat the 'comparison trap': 'Do not compare your beginning to someone else's middle.'

demos.title: A complete hotel check-in
demos.note: The target spans a multi-turn interaction from confirmation through farewell.
demos.query: Locate the complete interaction where a middle-aged male guest without a reservation successfully checks in for the first time. The segment should start when he confirms he has no reservation and end when the receptionist wishes him an enjoyable stay after giving him the key.

demos.title: Explaining a film mission
demos.note: A long explanatory segment with character, role, and plot constraints.
demos.query: Locate the segment where the female guest, in an explanatory tone, summarizes the movie's plot, introducing her character 'Zora Bennett' as a special ops soldier who accepts a life-changing mission to collect dinosaur DNA.

demos.title: 音乐转折、音效与独白
demos.note: 一秒混合事件，同时依赖背景音乐变化、叮声音效和人物独白。
demos.query: 定位出当背景音乐从温馨转为悬疑，并伴随一声清脆的“叮”音效时，女主角在内心独白中首次震惊地发现孩子脖子上有痣的那个瞬间。

demos.title: 掌声中的激烈反驳
demos.note: 目标由快速人声、情绪、关键词和观众掌声共同确定。
demos.query: 定位出一位语速极快、情绪极其激动的男性辩手，在观众雷鸣般的掌声中，首次使用“强奸犯”的比喻来反驳对方逻辑的那个片段。

demos.title: 故事与微弱闪光音效
demos.note: 长段叙事中包含弱音效，展示跨模态声学线索的组合定位。
demos.query: 定位出讲述者分享的那个让她感到“社死”又自豪的趣事，即她的儿子在放学时称她为“大明星”的完整故事。她的语气在此时非常温柔，且故事中段伴随有一个微弱的闪光音效。

demos.title: Resilience over ambient music
demos.note: A brief mixed event defined jointly by speech content and contemplative music.
demos.query: Locate the moment where the calm, decisive male speaker, against a backdrop of contemplative ambient music, delivers the impactful statement contrasting the fragility of civilization with the necessity for individual resilience.

demos.title: Late-night snacks and a song
demos.note: A narrative segment combining excitement, a time reference, and music context.
demos.query: Locate the moment the narrator expresses excitement over the late-night snacks served at 8 p.m. and mentions how a specific song got her carried away.

demos.title: Hibiscus sparkling water
demos.note: A long concluding explanation whose semantic boundary extends to a toast.
demos.query: Locate the concluding part of the vlog where the female speaker describes her specific method for creating a 'hibiscus sparkling water' concentrate and shares a toast.

demos.title: 金属零件的哗啦声
demos.note: 短促物体声嵌在音乐蒙太奇中，要求区分目标声与背景。
demos.query: 在第一次伴随着充满活力的粤语流行音乐的车辆制作蒙太奇中，可以听到许多小型金属零件（如螺栓）在金属容器中被摇晃发出的独特哗啦声，请定位这个特定的声学事件。

demos.title: 舒缓音乐下的味觉描述
demos.note: 该样例可用于人工检查粗粒度事件类型规则的边界。
demos.query: 定位出当背景音乐变得舒缓温馨时，博主首次用一系列文艺且富有比喻（如“盛夏的木栅”、“摇曳的火花”）的语言，详细描绘品尝自己做的肉炒肉时，味道在口中层层递进、爆发的感官体验。

demos.title: 爆炸后的身份揭露
demos.note: 声学触发点之后紧接长段自白，边界同时依赖声音与语义。
demos.query: 定位出在巨大爆炸声之后，外卖小哥的真实面目最终被揭露，他用木桩刺伤老范，并首次坦白自己此前还杀害了前女友夫妇的整个颠覆性自白片段。

demos.title: 游戏交流后的纯音乐
demos.note: 长音乐事件，目标是对人声结束后背景音乐区间进行定位。
demos.query: 定位出在激烈的游戏交流结束后，首次出现的那段旋律优美、氛围平静且略带感伤的纯背景音乐。

demos.title: Gunshot and body fall
demos.note: A compact non-speech sequence anchored by a request immediately before it.
demos.query: Locate the exact moment of the first audible gunshot followed by the sound of a body falling heavily to the floor, occurring immediately after a request for 'a little privacy.'

demos.title: Discovery on a city street
demos.note: A real-world scene combining exclamations with dense urban ambience.
demos.query: Locate the moment of sudden surprise and excitement where the vlogger and her friends first discover their friend on a huge billboard, with their exclamations set against the ambient sound of a busy New York City street.
